The famous ship that sank in 1912 after hitting an iceberg is the **RMS Titanic**.

To help you understand the concept of **Blockchain technology** using the analogy provided, here is a breakdown:

Imagine a traditional notebook (ledger) used by a single person or a single company to record transactions. If that person makes a mistake or decides to cheat, they can simply erase a line or change a number, and no one else might know. This is a centralized system.

Now, imagine a **Blockchain** as a group of 1,000 friends who all have identical notebooks. Every time a transaction happens (like "Alice pays Bob $10"), everyone writes it down in their own notebook at the same time.

1.  **Decentralized:** No single person holds the only copy. The record exists on all 1,000 notebooks.
2.  **Immutable:** Once a page is filled and agreed upon, it is sealed. You cannot go back and erase a line because the other 999 friends would see that your notebook no longer matches theirs.
3.  **Verified and Agreed Upon:** If Alice tries to change her notebook to say she paid Bob $100 instead of $10, the other 999 friends will compare their notebooks. Since 999 of them recorded "$10," the majority rules. Alice’s notebook is rejected as incorrect.

This system makes it extremely secure and trustworthy because it is nearly impossible for one person to alter the history without controlling the majority of the computers (notebooks), which is very difficult to do.
